name: Verify a Windows C workspace
description: Open a C project in VS Code, verify the intended GCC and GDB executables, compile a saved C17 source file with warnings enabled, and run the resulting executable from PowerShell.

name: Explain how C source becomes a running program
description: Distinguish source, preprocessing, compilation, linking, an executable file, and process output at beginner depth.

name: Read and repair early C diagnostics
description: Use the command, diagnostic severity, source location, and first relevant message to repair a syntax, declaration, or format-specifier problem without guessing.

name: Represent and print typed C values
description: Declare initialized int, double, and char objects and match each value to a correct printf conversion specifier.

name: Read one-shot numeric input safely
description: Use scanf for a bounded beginner input contract, supply writable object addresses, and check the conversion count before using any result.

name: Evaluate arithmetic and conversions predictably
description: Apply precedence, integer division, remainder, explicit conversion, and floating-point arithmetic so calculated output matches the stated value model.

name: Express ordered decisions
description: Use if, else if, and else in a deliberate order so invalid, boundary, unsuccessful, and successful cases take one explainable path.

name: Combine comparisons with logical operators
description: Use relational, equality, &&, ||, and ! expressions with short-circuit behavior to state a complete decision rule.

name: Validate before unsafe arithmetic or state changes
description: Reject invalid ranges and zero divisors before performing dependent calculations, then preserve a clear error path without using invalid values.

name: Repeat work with traceable progress
description: Use for and while loops with an intentional starting state, update, and stopping condition, and trace changing values without guessing.

name: Process fixed arrays within bounds
description: Declare initialized fixed-size arrays, distinguish element count from the last valid index, and traverse only initialized elements.

name: Summarize a bounded set of values
description: Use counters and accumulators to compute total, average, minimum, maximum, and threshold counts while handling the empty case deliberately.

name: Define focused functions and prototypes
description: Declare and define functions with purposeful names, parameter types, return types, and one understandable responsibility.

name: Return values and reason about pass-by-value
description: Compose returned results, keep temporary objects in local scope, and explain why changing a value parameter does not change the caller object.

name: Build and link a small multi-file C program
description: Place declarations in a guarded header, definitions in source files, compile all required translation units, and distinguish compiler errors from linker errors.

name: Handle bounded C strings
description: Treat a string as a NUL-terminated char array, measure capacity separately from text length, and copy or inspect text without reading or writing past its array.

name: Use pointers with a valid object and lifetime
description: Take an address, dereference only a valid pointer, check for NULL where required, and avoid returning or retaining an address after its object lifetime ends.

name: Model one record with a struct
description: Define a struct type whose members represent one coherent record, initialize independent objects, and access members with the appropriate operator.

name: Process fixed struct arrays through pointers
description: Search a bounded array of records, return a pointer to a matching live element or NULL, and update one record through a validated struct pointer.

name: Persist and parse bounded text records
description: Read and write a documented line format with FILE operations, bounded buffers, checked parse results, and capacity protection.

name: Handle file failures without destroying data
description: Distinguish a missing first-run file, another open failure, malformed existing content, end of file, and a read or close failure before any replacement write.

name: Debug one reproducible C failure
description: Build with warnings and debug symbols, reproduce one failing case, pause in VS Code or GDB, inspect relevant values and memory, repair one cause, and rerun the same case.

name: Verify behavior with a dependency-free check harness
description: Use small check functions to compare actual and expected normal, boundary, invalid, persistence, and no-mutation behavior with a visible final result.

name: Parse a small command-line contract
description: Check argc before reading argv, parse bounded command values, route supported commands, and show usable help for missing or unsupported input.

name: Document and publish a safe C repository
description: Write reproducible setup, compile, run, and check instructions; inspect staged paths; commit locally; and push source without executables, credentials, private data, or editor caches.
